author: shaarpie
body:
Hi, I am Sharpie. I am (for now, at least) a referee at the Overcast Network. I made some maps for them too, although they weren't accepted. Since it appears that OCN is closing, I would like to re-submit my maps in here.

This map is an update of a map I had already submitted to Avicus a year ago, the name was Two Towers I think. Anyway, I followed all the feedback the OCN mapdevs gave me and changed the map a lot.



The map features a weird layout, that I have honestly no idea how it will play. My idea was to make it hard to rush. 


To prevent skybridging from one wool to the other, height limit is lower in the main map and higher on the lanes. This is made through XML (which I think Avicus does support now). 

The size of the map would be around 20v20, I think.

Links:

Imgur

XML

Download

replies.author: shaarpie
replies.body:
The wool arrows are ugly but they are a way of showing which wool you are going to. As a player, a lot of times I get upset when if my team has a wool capped, and I am rushing, I end up in the wool we already have. The arrow helps me visualize that.

About the bedrock wall; my focus with this map was making rushing hard (it was made for OCN and I enjoy long matches over there). If they don't play well they can be removed.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Yes, we have an unbreakable thingy ;)

We also have a variety of other things, I'm doing the best I can to implement your XML

Just note:

"Filters" are "Checks" on Avicus

<apply></apply> are <zones><zone> and they are part of their own separate thingy.

Here's an example.

<zones>
    <zone region="manny's-armpits" modify="never"/>
</zones>

Your "kits" are our "loadouts" and our's have to be written like this:

Your's: <item>apple</item>

Our's: <item material="apple/>

Enchanting:

Your's: <item enchantment="...:2">apple</item>

Our's:
<item material="apple">
    <enchantment level="2">...</enchantment>
</item>
